XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault warning light comes on, poor performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P1453 | MIL | ON | LIGHTS UP | FILTER | PARTICULATE | PARTICULATE | PRESSURE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Particulate filter differential pressure sensor

  • Fault: Engine fault light comes on, poor performance. In some cases, recovery mode is activated.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1453 - Particulate filter differential pressure sensor

  • Cause: Damaged/deteriorated differential pressure sensor pipes

• Action: Check the integrity of the pipes connected to the differential pressure sensor, as they may be cracked, obstructed or damaged due to engine heat.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: This malfunction is statistically very common in this engine type.
